toml:
# Optical PNT through the atmosphere: three ILLUSTRATIVE ground sites (a cloudier northern site, a
# middling central site and a clearer southern site) viewing a LEO optical terminal at 30 degrees
# elevation at 1550 nm. The cloud climates are stated inputs, not measurements or any dataset's
# values, so every availability below is MODELLED. The run reports per site the clear-air loss,
# the Hufnagel-Valley turbulence state, the availability against the link margin, the margin
# needed for 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 percent (an optical link cannot pass thick cloud, so a site has an availability ceiling that no margin lifts, reported per site), the outage-duration distribution and the timing error
# growth per outage for three clock classes, then the site-diversity availability of the best 1, 2
# and 3 sites with independent and with distance-correlated weather (500 km decorrelation length).
kind = "optical-atmosphere"
wavelength_nm = 1550.0
elevation_deg = 30.0
availability_targets_pct = [40.0, 50.0, 60.0, 70.0]

[link]
tx_power_w = 0.5
tx_aperture_m = 0.1
rx_aperture_m = 0.4
range_km = 1000.0
optics_efficiency = 0.5
detector_efficiency = 0.7
pointing_loss_db = 3.0
receiver_sensitivity_dbm = -30.0

[atmosphere]
hv_ground_cn2 = 1.7e-14
hv_wind_ms = 21.0
wave = "plane"
direction = "downlink"
path_eff_km = 10.0
visibility_km = 23.0
aerosol_scale_height_m = 1200.0
top_km = 30.0
cloud_effective_radius_um = 10.0

[network]
correlation_length_km = 500.0

[clock]
classes = ["ocxo", "rafs", "dsac"]
threshold_ns = 100.0

[[site]]
name = "northern"
lat_deg = 58.0
lon_deg = 10.0
altitude_m = 50.0
p_cloud = 0.65
median_lwp_kg_m2 = 0.08
sigma_ln = 1.0
mean_outage_h = 9.0
outage_sigma_ln = 1.0
data_source = "ILLUSTRATIVE input, not a measurement"

[[site]]
name = "central"
lat_deg = 48.0
lon_deg = 11.0
altitude_m = 600.0
p_cloud = 0.5
median_lwp_kg_m2 = 0.06
sigma_ln = 1.0
mean_outage_h = 7.0
outage_sigma_ln = 1.0
data_source = "ILLUSTRATIVE input, not a measurement"

[[site]]
name = "southern"
lat_deg = 37.0
lon_deg = 14.0
altitude_m = 1200.0
p_cloud = 0.3
median_lwp_kg_m2 = 0.04
sigma_ln = 1.0
mean_outage_h = 5.0
outage_sigma_ln = 1.0
data_source = "ILLUSTRATIVE input, not a measurement"
summary: optical-atmosphere: 1550 nm at 30 deg elevation, margin 19.2 dB before the atmosphere; best site southern 74.66 %; 3-site network 92.72 % independent / 91.62 % correlated weather (MODELLED, advisory)
